description_zh: 查看目标集群的性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-performance --db-cluster-id amv-bp1hx5n1o8f610000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterPerformance

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of an enterprise edition, basic edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~~612397~~~) operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~~612397~~~)接口查看目标地域下所有集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the performance metric. Separate multiple keys with commas (,). For a list of supported metrics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的性能指标名称（监控项Key），多个值之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。支持查询的指标详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range. The time is in UTC and must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range. The time is in UTC and must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.

The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed two days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过两天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the regions and availability zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including the region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource pool
parameters.name: resource_pools

DBClusterId.description_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the [DescribeDBClusters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html） operation to query the IDs of all clusters in a specific region
DBClusterId.description_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html）接口查看目标地域下所有集群的集群ID

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time is in UTC and uses the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

Key.description_en: The name of the performance metric

Series.description_en: The time series data for the metric

items.description_en: The details of a time series

Name.description_en: The name of the performance metric. This parameter is the Value Name of the monitoring metric. For more information, see [Overview of Monitoring Items]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）
Name.description_zh: 性能指标名称（监控指标Value Name）。详情请参见[监控项概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）

Tags.description_en: A JSON string that contains the tags for the metric series

TranslateKey.description_en: A key for internal internationalization (i18n). You can safely ignore this parameter
TranslateKey.description_zh: 做国际化翻译的key，日常不需要关注

Values.description_en: An array of data points for the time series
Values.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

items.description_en: A data point, which is an array that contains a timestamp string and a value string
items.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

Unit.description_en: The unit of the monitoring metric

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time is in UTC and uses the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
